name: Dr. Umar Un Nabi
real_life_parallel: Red Fort car bomber (November 2025); doctor-led JeM cell; 'white-collar terror'

biography.background: Doctor alleged to be part of Faridabad-based 'white-collar' Jaish-e-Mohammed cell. Mastermind of Red Fort car bombing November 10, 2025. Hyundai i20 with ammonium nitrate; 15 killed. Motive: avenge family members of Masood Azhar killed in Operation Sindoor strikes.
biography.profile: Educated professional; medical background; represents 'white-collar terror' shift
biography.cell_composition: Muzammil Ganaie, Umar Mohammed (fellow doctors/professionals); allegedly recruited by Pakistani handlers via social media
biography.target: Red Fort — symbolic of Indian sovereignty; timing (post-Sindoor vengeance)
biography.film_relevance: Part 4 epilogue: Grim reminder war continues; 'sleeper' white-collar threat; sets Part 5

faction.motivation: Vengeance for Azhar family killed in Sindoor
